findings.statement: The component-width delta family W can be removed from both SIGN and SIGNED_PARITY exchange triangles on every hard carrier without changing scalar exactness.
C+D0+D1 is the unique inclusion-minimal common exact token-family subset under both common gauges. It retains role-capacity phase plus both owner-separated exact-depth channels.
On 4x5-k4 every strict subset of C+D0+D1 is scalar-inexact, so C, D0, and D1 are each load-bearing within the frozen family lattice on that carrier.
Horizontal-only 6x3-k4 is exact with D0+D1 alone, so C is not a universally necessary family on each geometry even though it is required by the common cross-carrier support.
6x3-k3 admits two incomparable minimal supports, C+D1 and D0+D1, while C+D0 fails. The common requirement is therefore determined by transfer across carriers rather than one carrier alone.
